parameters.name: first_frame_image
last_frame_image
parameters.description:
The model will use the image passed in this parameter to generate the final frame of the video. 
- 512P resolution is not supported when using the last frame parameter. 
- When the aspect ratios of the first and last frame images are inconsistent, the model will generate the video based on the aspect ratio of the first frame and crop the last frame.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description:
- The prompt describes the desired elements and visual features in the generated video.

- Chinese and English are supported. Each Chinese character or letter counts as one character. Text exceeding the limit is automatically truncated.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Specifies the resolution tier for the generated video.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The duration of the generated video, in seconds. Affects pricing.

parameters.name: watermark
parameters.description: Specifies whether to add a watermark. The watermark contains the fixed text `AI Generated` and is placed in the lower-right corner of the video.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to be synthesized into speech. Maximum input of 2,000 characters.

parameters.name: voice_id
parameters.description: The voice to use for speech synthesis. 65 voices across 16 languages available.

parameters.name: audio_encoding
parameters.description: The desired output format of the synthesized audio. LINEAR16 includes WAV header.

parameters.name: sample_rate_hertz
parameters.description: The synthesis sample rate in Hz. Default is 48000. Supported: 8000, 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100, 48000.

parameters.name: speaking_rate
parameters.description: Speaking rate/speed, in the range [0.5, 1.5]. Default is 1.0. Values above 0.8 recommended for high quality.

parameters.name: bit_rate
parameters.description: Bits per second of the audio. Only for compressed formats (MP3, OGG_OPUS). Default is 128000.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Randomness when sampling audio tokens (0-2). Default 1.1. Higher values produce more expressive results.

parameters.name: timestamp_type
parameters.description: Controls timestamp metadata returned. WORD includes phoneticDetails with viseme symbols for lip-sync. Enabling adds latency.

parameters.name: apply_text_normalization
parameters.description: Automatically expands numbers, dates, times, and abbreviations. OFF reduces latency but reads text exactly as written.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content to be converted to speech.

parameters.name: voice_id
parameters.description: Voice ID for speech synthesis.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Speech speed multiplier.

parameters.name: vol
parameters.description: Volume level multiplier.

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: Pitch adjustment in semitones.

parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: Emotion control for synthesized speech. By default, the model automatically selects the most natural emotion based on text. Manual specification is only recommended when explicitly needed.

parameters.name: language_boost
parameters.description: Controls whether recognition for specific minority languages and dialects is enhanced. Default is null. If the language type is unknown, set to 'auto' and the model will automatically detect it.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specifies the format of the generated audio. Default is mp3.

parameters.name: audio_sample_rate
parameters.description: Specifies the sampling rate of the generated audio. Default is 32000 Hz.

parameters.name: bitrate
parameters.description: Specifies the bitrate of the generated audio. Default is 128000. Note: This parameter only applies to audio in mp3 format.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Specifies the number of audio channels. 1 = mono, 2 = stereo. Default is 2 (stereo).

parameters.name: vm_pitch
parameters.description: Voice modification pitch adjustment. Adjusts the pitch of the synthesized voice for voice-changing effects. Range: -100 (lower) to 100 (higher).

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: Voice intensity adjustment. Controls the strength/power of the voice. Range: -100 (weaker) to 100 (stronger).

parameters.name: timbre
parameters.description: Voice timbre adjustment. Modifies the tonal quality and character of the voice. Range: -100 to 100.

parameters.name: sound_effects
parameters.description: Applies special sound effects to the synthesized voice. These effects can create atmospheric or stylistic variations.

parameters.name: lyrics
parameters.description: Song lyrics (1-3500 characters). Use line breaks to separate lines. You can add structure tags like [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Intro], [Outro] to enhance arrangement.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: A description of the music style, mood, and scenario (0-2000 characters). For example: 'Pop, melancholic, perfect for a rainy night' or 'Upbeat electronic, energetic, dance club'.

parameters.name: sample_rate
parameters.description: Audio sample rate in Hz.

parameters.name: bitrate
parameters.description: Audio bitrate in bps. Higher bitrate means better quality.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output audio format.
